arabic text: ABBAS KE PARCHAM KE SAAYE ME CHALE AAWO\nABBAS SE MANGO ABBAS WASEELA HAI.
english translation text: Come beneath Abbas's standard;\nask Abbas, for Abbas is the means.

arabic text: DUNYA KE GHAMO SE JAB GHABRAWO BIKHAR JAAWO\nABBAS KE PARCHAM KE SAAYE ME CHALE AAWO\nGHAMKHWAARE HUSSAINI KE GHAM DOOR YEH KARTA HAI
english translation text: When the sorrows of the world frighten you and you fall apart,\ncome beneath Abbas's standard.\nHe removes the grief of Hussain's mourners.

arabic text: CHAAYE HO MUSALAL GHAM, BE CHAYN HO DIL HAR DAM\nSHAHZADI SAKINA KE AMOO KO PUKAARO TUM\nWOH BAABE HAWAIJ HE SAQAAE SAKINA HAI
english translation text: If grief continually surrounds you and the heart remains restless,\ncall upon the uncle of Princess Sakina.\nHe is the Gate of Needs and Sakina's water-bearer.

arabic text: DARGAH PE GHAZI KI JO KOI BHI AAYA HO\nKUCH FARQ NAHI PARHTA APNA HO PARAYA HO\nDARBAR SE GHAZI KE KHALI NAHIN LOTA HAI
english translation text: Whoever comes to Ghazi's shrine—\nwhether stranger or loved one—\nnever returns empty-handed from Ghazi's court.

arabic text: WOH JIS SE WAFA NE BHI SIKHI HAI WAFADARI\nHATHON KE BINA JISKI QAAIM HAI ALAMDARI\nHATHON KO KABHI KHALI REHNE NAHI DETA HAI
english translation text: Even loyalty learned faithfulness from him;\nhis standard-bearing remains established despite having no hands.\nHe never allows anyone's hands to remain empty.

arabic text: HAAN SOORAT O SEERAT ME HAIDER KA YE SAANI HAI\nABBAS BINE HAIDER HAIDER KI JAWANI HAI\nPHIR NADE ALI KA TO EK YEH BHI SALIQA HAI
english translation text: In both appearance and character he is the second Haider.\nAbbas son of Haider is Haider's youth.\nThis too is a way of reciting Nad-e-Ali.

arabic text: KHAIME ME SAKINA NE BACHON SE KAHAA AAWO\nGHABRAO NAHI APNE KUZON KO UTHA LAWO\nAY PYASON AGAR DEKHO PAANI TUMHE PEENA HAI
english translation text: Within the tents, Sakina told the children: come,\ndo not fear—lift your little cups.\nO thirsty ones, if you wish to drink water...

arabic text: MOLA KI ZIYARAT KO JO KARBALA JATA HAI\nWO IZNE ZIYARAT BHI ABBAS SE PATA HAI\nROZE PE AGAR TUMKO SHABBIR KE JANA HAI
english translation text: Whoever goes to Karbala for the Maula's visitation\nreceives permission for visitation from Abbas.\nTo reach Shabbir's shrine, first go to his shrine.

arabic text: SHABBIR KE SADQE ME SALMAN AGAR MAANGA\nABBAS KI CHOKAT SE RAD HOTE NAHIN DEKHA\nJISKO BHI AGAR PANA SHABIR KA SAQDA HAI
english translation text: O Salman, whoever asks through Shabbir's charity\nis never seen rejected from Abbas's threshold.\nWhoever wishes to receive Shabbir must seek his charity.

arabic text: SALMAN O KARIM HUMNE TA UMR YEH DEKHA HAI\nIZZAT HO KE SHOHRAT HO SHABBIR KA SADQA HAI
english translation text: O Salman and Karim, throughout our lives we have seen:\nwhether honour or fame, all is the charity of Shabbir.
